You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

The patch modifies a single file, `fs/ntfs3/run.c`, to fix an integer overflow vulnerability in the `run_unpack()` function’s volume boundary check. The original code `lcn + len > sbi->used.bitmap.nbits` could wrap around for large values of `lcn` and `len`, bypassing the validation. The fix replaces the raw addition with `check_add_overflow(lcn, len, &lcn_end)`, returning `-EINVAL` if overflow is detected or if the resulting `lcn_end` exceeds `sbi->used.bitmap.nbits`. This change is consistent with similar overflow-safe checks already present in the same function for adjacent calculations (`prev_lcn + dlcn` and `vcn64 + len`).
